headline: Mid‑tier firms post strong growth while top‑tier players see modest revenue gains and tighter guidance.
summary: Coforge leads with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance. Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance to 1‑2% after only 1.5% growth. HCLTech and TCS report solid AI‑driven profit expansion. Wipro shows revenue growth but a 1.9% profit decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: AI revenue rose sharply at Infosys (29% YoY), HCLTech ($219 m), TCS ($3.1 bn) and LTM (47% YoY).

themes.title: Margin pressure on large caps
themes.detail: Infosys cut guidance and sees modest operating margin; Wipro profit slipped despite revenue growth.

themes.title: Mid‑tier growth surge
themes.detail: Coforge, LTM and Tech Mahindra posted double‑digit revenue growth, outpacing the market.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised FY27 EBIT margin guidance to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY27 guidance was cut to 1‑2%.
